recognition_primary: 65% mean per-image reference-supported coarse-object F1 across 24 COCO images + 35% target-text recall across eight TextVQA images. Invalid service responses score zero. Counts and paired robustness are separate secondary metrics.
moderation_primary: Equal-category macro F2. Abstained or invalid positive references count as missed detection; unknown references are excluded from Boolean confusion counts and reported separately.
anti_bias: No model-as-judge. Alias dictionary accepts standard equivalent object names; labels came from public annotations plus visual review, without candidate output feedback. OCR matching ignores case/spacing/punctuation but preserves distinct numbers and brands.
limits: One reviewer, small per-category positives, published validation data may have been in model pretraining. No production-certification, movie, multi-image or non-English claim.
owner_data_choice: Use public research datasets for now (user reply, 2026-10-28). Evaluation only, no training approval.

scorer_revisions.reason: Pre-final-scoring unit review caught compound-class ambiguity: hot dog is not dog, teddy bear is not wild bear, baseball bat is not a ball, jet ski is not airplane. Applied equally to every model; no reference or metric-weight changes.
Pre-final-scoring robustness: malformed nonobject outputs remain invalid instead of crashing; metrics with no applicable denominator remain null. Covered by unit tests; no reference/weight changes.

Normalization unit review: numeric OCR retains digit identity when a unit/label has an omitted space (75anos, Player16); 6 never matches 16 and 75 never matches 175/750. No reference, weight, or model-specific adjustment.

reference_revisions.reason: Full-resolution review corrected one scene from ambiguous social/drink interpretation to explicit adult-appearing acts; added a public-domain nonsexual sculpture contrast. No model output used.

operating_profile_revisions.reason: As-is service reasoning consumed response allowance; native diagnostic recorded 1030 reasoning characters and length termination. No reasoning content retained. Corrected real API preflight completed.
